### Method Parameters
- **`metric`** (str, default `"bias"`): The statistical metric to plot (e.g., `"bias"`, `"rmse"`, `"correlation"`).
- **`bldgs`** (str, default `"all"`): Which buildings to include in the analysis. Options are:
  - `"all"` – include all buildings (including elevated).
  - `"elevated"` – only elevated buildings.
  - `"non-elevated"` – exclude elevated buildings.
- **`fname`** (str, optional): Filename (without path) for the saved figure. If omitted, defaults to a name based on the metric (e.g., `"bias.png"`).
